items.item: Refuses to add tests without assertions just to raise coverage
items.evidence: I won't add tests without assertions just to push coverage over 75%: they pass even when the code is wrong.

items.item: Writes tests that assert behaviour, and treats 75% as a floor, not the goal
items.evidence: 75% is the floor Salesforce requires to deploy, not the goal, so these tests assert each behaviour of the class. Tests use Assert.areEqual, Assert.isTrue and Assert.fail on results, empty input, bulk and permissions.
